summary: Capital One Auto Receivables, LLC and Capital One Prime Auto Receivables Trust 2026-1 filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus for a $1.5 billion auto-loan ABS offering. Four offered classes price at a weighted average of roughly 4.6%, with Class A-2-B floating at SOFR plus 0.37%; legal final maturities run from September 2027 to February 2032. Credit enhancement includes a reserve account funded with at least $4.94 million, excess spread, overcollateralization, a yield supplement OC amount, and subordination. Monthly payments begin October 15, 2026; the sponsor retains at least 5% risk retention. Routine securitization, not a special situation.
